event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hot CPI breaks the AI trade.
Sept CPI printed 3.7% y/y vs 3.6% fc and 0.6% m/m as forecast, core 0.3% vs 0.2% fc; that lifted hike odds and crushed rate-sensitive semis, sending SOXX -4.50% while defensives XLV +2.53% and XLP +2.22% caught the bid. Polymarket now prices 32% for a 25bp October hike, +16pp in five days — that repricing, not earnings, drove the tape.

INDICES — VIX 16.9, above its 15.4 20-day MA.
DIA -0.11%, SPY -1.08%, IJH -1.35%, IWM -1.93%, QQQ -1.97%, SOXX -4.50%. Large beat small by 0.51pp. Biggest cross-asset move: SLV -6.11%, with TLT +0.66% as the only real haven bid.

VOLUME & BREATH — QQQ traded 1.5x average on a -1.97% day: distribution, not dip-buying. SPY's screen ran below QQQ's pace with -1.08%, so the heaviest selling concentrated in megacap tech, not the broad index. Breadth diverges hard: only 35% of S&P 500 names above the 50-DMA, 48% above the 200-DMA, adv/dec 241/259, up/down volume 0.58, and 50 new 60-day lows against 31 highs — participation is deteriorating, not confirming.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.53%, XLP Staples +2.22%, XLE Energy +0.64%, XLB Materials -0.10%, XLU Utilities -0.36%, XLF Financials -0.55%, XLY Discretionary -0.77%, XLRE Real Estate -0.81%, XLI Industrials -0.97%, XLC Comms -1.30%, XLK Technology -2.98%. Top industries: IBB +1.61%, XRT +0.44%; bottom: DRAM -5.11%, WGMI -10.67%. Flows contradict the tape — XLK pulled +$1,320mm (100th pct) and XLC +$1,005mm (98th pct) into a -2.98% and -1.30% day, while XLI bled just -$22mm. That gap between price and flows says Friday's selling was repositioning, not conviction exit. Money is moving defensively: XLV and XLP in, XLK and SOXX-linked semis out. Defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.96 and IWM 1.02 show real protection demand; QQQ PCR 0.85 and skew +6.3% mean puts are bid but not panic-priced. VIXEQ 40.3 versus VIX 16.9 is a wide dispersion gap — low implied correlation, a rotation and stock-picker tape rather than a macro one. QQQ ATM IV 18.0% against SPY's 10.8% confirms the fear is tech-specific.

CROSS-ASSET — Silver -6.11% and gold -1.49% fell despite the risk-off tape, an unusual break from the usual haven chain, while the dollar (UUP +0.34%) and TLT +0.66% absorbed the CPI repricing. Next FOMC is Oct 28; Polymarket prices 68% no change and 32% for a 25bp hike, the hike leg up 16pp in five days. Tomorrow brings PPI (fc 0.5% m/m), retail sales (fc 0.3%) and jobless claims (fc 200k) — the CPI-follow-through test.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 55.2, Neutral. Movers: ORCL -8.83%, MRVL -8.72%, NET -6.72%, BAC -4.76%; BAC printed a 3.1x volume spike on a down day — distribution. Watch tomorrow: SOXX -4.50% and XLK -2.98% (semis-led unwind, but XLK flows are +$1,320mm at the 100th percentile — flow/price divergence), SLV -6.11% (2.4x volume spike, GEX flip 44 vs spot, deep negative gamma), and XLV +2.53% (1.5x volume, only sector at fresh relative highs).
